USEFUL SHOULD BE REACHABLE

Accessibility statement.

Nepocore aims to make common tasks usable on small screens and with a keyboard. The interface includes labeled fields, visible focus, a skip link, semantic headings, result status messages, color-theme controls and reduced-motion support. These features are ongoing work, not a claim of certified WCAG conformance.

Ways to adjust the experience

Use the theme button for a different color scheme and the motion button to pause decorative animation. System reduced-motion preferences are respected. Browser zoom can enlarge text. Most tools support text entry and file uploads without camera access.

Known limits

Drawing a signature, positioning some image crops and manipulating visual designs can require pointer input. The room planner also provides numeric positions as an alternative to dragging. Generated raster images and many printable PDFs do not contain a fully tagged accessible document structure. Provide a text description or another accessible version when sharing them.

Speech synthesis depends on installed browser or operating-system voices. Camera, microphone, clipboard, download and print features vary across browsers and assistive technologies. Some complex data tables may require horizontal scrolling.

Report a barrier

Email admin@nepocore.com with the tool URL, blocked action, browser and assistive technology if you wish to share it. A sample input is helpful; private files are unnecessary. We welcome concrete reports and will use them to improve the relevant interaction.
